title: My Love Mine All Mine
lyrics:
[00:09.18]Moon, a hole of light
[00:12.88]Through the big top tent up high
[00:17.15]Here, before and after me
[00:21.18]Shinin' down on me
[00:26.20]Moon, tell me if I could
[00:29.74]Send up my heart to you?
[00:33.84]So, when I die, which I must do
[00:37.46]Could it shine down here with you?
[00:42.04]'Cause my love is mine, all mine
[00:46.39]I love, mine, mine, mine
[00:50.73]Nothing in the world belongs to me
[00:54.53]But my love, mine, all mine, all mine
[01:18.74]My baby here on Earth
[01:22.35]Showed me what my heart was worth
[01:26.38]So, when it comes to be my turn
[01:30.14]Could you shine it down here for her?
[01:34.46]'Cause my love is mine, all mine
[01:39.06]I love, mine, mine, mine
[01:43.36]Nothing in the world belongs to me
[01:47.23]But my love, mine, all mine
[01:51.90]Nothing in the world is mine for free
[01:55.57]But my love, mine, all mine, all mine
